contract: Entity has and get must return the results they would return after flush. This is an observational-equivalence requirement, not a requirement that world.has or all observers are equal at every phase.

hypotheses.name: Deferred get omits schema defaults for partial parameters
hypotheses.mechanism: deferredGet returns pending params directly. The live add path merges schema defaults into those params for a regular structure-of-arrays trait. TraitValue explicitly permits Partial records. A missing parameter field can therefore be absent before flush and have its default after flush.
hypotheses.distinguishing_scenario: An original trait has one or more default fields. Add it to an entity without that trait with a legal partial record. Compare an independent snapshot or primitive field of entity.get before and after flush. Do not retain original assertions for fields whose inputs changed.
premises: Use an ordinary structure-of-arrays trait, not an array-of-structures factory.
The trait is initially absent, with no external callback mutation.
The observation must avoid retaining a mutable alias across flush.
The original complete test remains the separate control.

hypotheses.name: Projection excludes cross-entity destruction effects
hypotheses.mechanism: Projected state replays commands only for the queried entity. The flush path computes relation effects and autoDestroy over multiple entities. A pending destruction of a related entity can alter the queried entity or its relation at flush without altering its pre-flush has/get projection.
hypotheses.distinguishing_scenario: An original autoDestroy relation connects two live entities. Defer destruction of one. Observe a public trait or relation through has/get on the affected other entity before and after flush. No claim is made for world.has or isAlive, which the public equivalence sentence does not name.
premises: Recover relation direction and autoDestroy mode from the actual original declaration.
Use has/get only under the explicit public equivalence requirement.
Keep world and entity identities fixed and exclude intervening mutation.
Audit relation cleanup and cascading semantics for the full test.

existing_search_limits: The original deferred tests already contain before/after observations. Missing all phase observations is therefore an inaccurate diagnosis.
R06 source census found world.has locations that did not bind the explicit entity has/get contract. It correctly declined to execute these hypotheses.
The default-value hypothesis needs a new discriminating input plus a corresponding valid observation; appending a stronger assertion to unchanged one-field full inputs can still pass.
The relation hypothesis requires identifying the affected entity across a relation. Same-receiver matching alone is insufficient.
research_implication: The useful abstraction is contract-bound observational equivalence over an operation and its dependent state. A phase label or generic getter chain is not sufficient. A future method must bind the contract subject, choose a legal input that distinguishes omitted state, and preserve an independent oracle.
novelty_limits: This source diagnosis does not establish algorithmic novelty. A contribution would need a uniform construction that gains capability on multiple unseen contract families, compared under equal information and budget.
